D/ A VITELLIVS IMP GERMAN ; R/ CONSENSVS/EXERCIT[...]

A denarius of Vitellius dating to AD 69. CONSENSVS EXERCITVVM reverse. Spanish mint, probably at Tarraco (Tarragona). RIC I, p. 269, no. 24. Obverse shows laureate bust left. Obverse legend reads A VITELLIVS IMP GERMAN. Reverse shows Mars advancing left holding spear, aquila and vexillum. Reverse legend reads CONSENSVS/EXERCIT[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 3.58, diameter 18.27mm,…
